MotionBeatz — Gesture-Controlled Music Player

A computer-vision-based music player that uses hand-gesture recognition to control playback, volume, and track navigation.

Computer visionHand-gesture recognition
01 / THE DETAILS

The problem & intended users

Conventional music players use onscreen playback controls. MotionBeatz explores hand gestures as another way to control listening.

Listeners interested in controlling music through hand gestures.

02 / THE DETAILS

The approach

Recognize hand gestures through computer vision and connect those gestures to playback, volume adjustment, and track navigation.

03 / THE DETAILS

My contribution

Developed the computer-vision-based music player and its gesture-driven playback, volume, and track-navigation controls.

04 / THE DETAILS

Challenges & lessons

A gesture interface needs clear mappings so each movement feels connected to the intended playback action.

The interaction is easier to learn when gestures follow a consistent vocabulary and the player makes their effects visible.

05 / THE DETAILS

Current status

Portfolio project.

06 / THE DETAILS

Where it could go next

Proposed next steps: add a short interaction demo, document the gesture vocabulary, and evaluate recognition across lighting conditions.
